current_date: July 2024 (adopted by the Licensing and Planning Policy Committee on 11 July 2024)
current_evidence: The council's 'Local validation list' page links only this PDF. Its cover reads 'July 2024' and says it was adopted on 11 July 2024 after consultation from 25 April to 26 May 2024. A search found only the 2024 committee papers and no later list.

issues.detail: The List date 2015-04-01 ('dated April 2015') is wrong for the linked document. The PDF is the July 2024 list, adopted on 11 July 2024. The 2015 date appears to come from the page's 2015 metadata and the superseded 'Local Requirements List April 2015.pdf'. 'Outdated (>2y)? Yes' is right only because July 2024 is now just over two years old, not because the list dates from 2015.
issues.evidence: Cover: 'July 2024' ... 'adopted by the Council's Licensing and Planning Policy Committee on 11 July 2024'; 'consulted from 25 April to 26 May 2024'

issues.detail: Grokbot also read the superseded 2015 list (Local Requirements List April 2015.pdf) and used it for several rows. These are both Householder rows (Daylight/Sunlight, Sunlight to gardens), Crime Impact Statement, Housing mix/NDSS (whose trigger is actually 2015 Air Quality text), LVIA, both Outline rows (CIL, D&AS), the prior approval FRA, and all the 'Planning Obligations' rows under LBC, Advert, LDC, Prior approval, Works to trees and Hazardous substances.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows source = 'Local%20Requirements%20List%20April%202015.pdf' with text '4.8 Daylight / Sunlight Assessment 4.8.1 ...'

issues.detail: 'Planning Obligations / S106 draft Heads of Terms' is listed as 'Application type named' under Listed building consent, Advertisement consent, Lawful development cert, Change of use prior approval, Works to trees and Hazardous substances. The source text is a 2015 paragraph listing application types that have different national requirements ('amending planning obligations; lawful development certificates; prior approval...; non-planning consents'). It is not a requirement for any of them. In the 2024 list, Draft Legal Agreement is 'Optional, but usually on major developments'.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger: ' amending planning obligations;  lawful development certificates;  prior approval for some permitted development rights;  non-planning consents (such as advertisement consent, listed building consent...'

issues.detail: The 2024 list is explicitly split by application type: Householder pp.5-13, Full pp.14-34, an Outline/Reserved Matters matrix, Permission in Principle, LBC, Advertisement and LDC tables. Grokbot nevertheless put about 37 rows under Full planning as 'INFERRED: application type not named', and showed Reserved matters and Permission in Principle as '(none)'. BNG, for example, is 'All development, except for householders', so it applies to Outline and PiP as well. The Outline/RM and PiP matrices list dozens of requirements by stage.
issues.evidence: Section headings 'OUTLINE PLANNING PERMISSION', 'APPROVAL OF RESERVED MATTERS', 'PERMISSION IN PRINCIPLE', 'LISTED BUILDING CONSENT', 'ADVERTISEMENT CONSENT'

issues.detail: Householder local requirements in the 2024 list are not captured. Grokbot has only two Householder rows, both from the 2015 list. Missing: Floor plans (extensions or alterations); Roof plan (alterations to above-ground floors); Elevations (extensions and boundary treatments); Sections (loft conversions, basements, significant slopes); Streetscene (increase in ridge height or substantial change in scale); D&AS (>100m2 created and in a conservation area); AIA (works likely to affect mature trees on or adjacent to the site); AMS; PEA (on/within/adjacent to an SSSI, priority habitat, bat or GCN triggers); Phase 2 bat emergence survey; Heritage Statement (listed, locally listed or CA); Parking and Access Plan (changes to access or parking, loss of parking, more bedrooms); FRA (ground-floor development in FZ2/3 or a Critical Drainage Area); Daylight/Sunlight ('where there is an above ground floor extension'); Green Belt Statement (any extension or outbuilding in the Green Belt); Contaminated Land Assessment; CIL Form 1 (all); CIL Form 2 (>100m2 additional floorspace).
issues.evidence: Householder table pp.5-13, e.g. 'Green Belt Statement - Any extension to a building or any new outbuilding (or extension to it) within the Green Belt'

issues.detail: Full planning items in the 2024 list that are not captured: Green Belt Statement (any development in the Green Belt); Survey Plan and Accommodation Schedule (major and larger minor schemes); Travel Plan; Stage 1 Road Safety Audit (larger majors altering the public highway); Delivery Management Plan (major commercial); Construction Management Plan (majors); Car Park Management Plan (majors and larger residential); Refuse and Recycling Plan (any additional floorspace or dwellings); Public Rights of Way Statement; Operational Management Plan (schools, day care, care homes); Glare Assessment (large solar or large glazing); Detailed Specifications (AC units, heat pumps, commercial exhaust); Hydrogeological Report; Confirmation from Utilities Provider (majors); Needs Assessment (student or care homes, traveller pitches); Disabled Access Statement and Plan (new buildings and majors); Contaminated Land Assessment; Landscape Management Plan (majors); Noise, Odour and Vibration Assessment as such (only partly captured as 'Ventilation'); ICNIRP declaration and Alternative Sites Statement (all telecoms applications); HMO licence (optional, large HMO >6 occupants).
issues.evidence: Full Planning table pp.14-34, e.g. 'Detailed Specifications - For applications including AC units, heat pumps, commercial exhaust, or other similar facilities'

issues.detail: The type-specific tables for other application types are not captured. LBC requires a Heritage Statement and D&AS for all applications, plus floor, roof and elevation plans, detailed plans and specialist reports 'relative to the proposed alterations'. Advertisement consent requires elevations for all applications, a Heritage Statement where signage or lighting is fixed to a listed or locally listed building or is in a CA, and an optional photomontage. The Outline/RM and PiP stage 1/stage 2 matrices are also not captured.
issues.evidence: LISTED BUILDING CONSENT table: 'Heritage Statement: all applications'; ADVERTISEMENT CONSENT: 'Heritage Statement: signage or lighting affixed to a listed building, locally listed building, or within a conservation area'

issues.detail: Many rows take their trigger from the neighbouring requirement in the table. Arboricultural Impact Assessment has the D&AS trigger ('>100m2 and the site is within a conservation area'); the source says 'For major development and where works are likely to affect mature trees'. Flood Risk Assessment has the Parking and Access Plan trigger; the source says majors, FZ2/3 or a Critical Drainage Area. Heritage Statement has the bat Phase 2 text; the source says works to listed or locally listed buildings or in a CA. Daylight/Sunlight (Full) has noise text; the source says majors or potential adverse impact on nearby properties. Affordable Housing has the viability text; the source says 'net increase of 10 more dwellings'. Schedule of works has the Arboricultural Method Statement text. Telecoms has the HMO licence and draft legal agreement text. Gypsy & Traveller is a fragment of the Needs Assessment/Retail rows. Housing mix/NDSS has 2015 Air Quality text.
issues.evidence: Grokbot FRA trigger: 'Parking and Access Plan Flood Risk Assessment Required where amendments are proposed to access or parking arrangements...'

issues.detail: Several rows use boilerplate or garbled text instead of a trigger. Ecological Survey, Marketing and Viability all use the general note that surveys should be 'no older than 12 months'. The 2024 list has no marketing-report item, and its PEA trigger is 'major development, and all development where priority habitat is affected'. Photomontage is a jumble of headings plus 1948 volume text; the source says major and larger minor schemes. Planning Statement, Roof plan and Landscaping are merged with adjacent rows. Energy cites EcoHomes/Code for Sustainable Homes; the source gives Energy Statement for majors and Sustainability Statement for all non-major development. Fire Statement quotes the national form; the local item is 'Fire Risk Assessment - buildings >7 storeys/18m'.
issues.evidence: Grokbot Ecological Survey trigger: 'Any surveys required with the application (e.g., bat surveys, marketing reports or viability assessments) should be no older than 12 months'

issues.detail: The 'Submission rules' tab_items are process text, not requirements: a preference for PDF format and a single plans document, 'It is not necessary to submit individual pdf documents', and 'After this time, your invalid application will be returned.' 'Drawing standards' also has a duplicated 1:50/1:100 scale-bar row carrying table-header junk ('16 Requirement When required Guidance').
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'After this time, your invalid application will be returned. 12.'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current July 2024 list (adopted 11 July 2024), but it is dated April 2015, and many rows come from the superseded 2015 list. The 2024 list is organised by application type, yet Grokbot dumped most items under Full planning with cross-wired triggers, misassigned S106 to six consent types, and missed most Householder, LBC, Advert, Outline/RM and about 20 Full planning requirements.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
